policy.selection: validation F1 for binary; max auto coverage at empirical 95% precision per auto action and >=50 validation support; rules prohibit auto-pass

quality.normalization: NFKC+lower+alphanumeric only; test > validation > train; conflicting binary groups removed

routing.release_gate: BLOCKED: test block precision below validation target; offline demo only

latency.method: 200 sequential single-item warm calls; vectorize + classifier + rules + route; perf_counter; one CPU thread; excludes startup, DB, network, human

assumptions.note: 仅情景假设，非供应商报价；没有API调用
